Name: Smart Pipes
Author: Meeeeei
Description:
[b]Smart Pipes[/b]
[url=https://github.com/ParfaitRana/SmartPipes#smart-pipes][/url]
Smart Pipes is a logistics mod for Stardew Valley. Build pipe networks between chests, machines, and shipping bins, then use filters and priorities to decide exactly where every item may go.
It is designed around one rule: [b]items only move when there is a valid destination[/b]. A full machine or chest will never turn your ingredients into unintended shipping-bin sales.
[b]Current release:[/b] [url=https://github.com/ParfaitRana/SmartPipes/releases/latest]1.0.0[/url]

This is a vibe coding project.

For more information, issue reports, or suggestions pls visit the github repository: [url=https://github.com/ParfaitRana/SmartPipes]Link[/url]
